name: Barrel Bandits
summary:
Barrel Bandits is a desert-themed multiplayer, where you and your friends find creative ways to earn money and explore a dusty open world. Start small and gradually unlock new activities as you move up the chain.

Buy vehicles, tweak their style, and make deliveries across the map. Fuel stations, odd jobs, and questionable side gigs are all part of the journey. Team up, cause a little chaos, or just enjoy the ride.
